image_description: A close-up, high-contrast photograph of a worn baseball resting on a wooden surface. The ball is illuminated by a strong light source from the left, casting deep shadows to the right. The white leather cover is stained and scuffed, showing signs of use. The characteristic red stitching is visible but appears somewhat irregular and fused in areas due to the wear or generation artifacts. There is illegible black text or markings on the side of the ball.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the stitching. Real baseballs have very specific, raised, double-stitched red threads. AI often fails here, making them look like painted red lines or melted blobs. Also, evaluate the black markings—are they a brand logo or gibberish? The 'worn' look might mask some artifacts, so distinguish between realistic dirt/scuffs and generative errors.
